title: Immich: first weekend
summary: Docker Compose on the lab box, open the web UI, point the phone at LAN. Mark installed when uploads work.

start.body: Immich is a photo library you run. This weekend: get Compose up and one phone uploading. Not a full migration yet.

prereq.body: You need Docker + Compose on the lab box, a disk with room, and the box reachable on LAN. No public expose this weekend.

need-docker.body: Install Docker Engine from the official docs for your OS, then docker compose version. Come back when that prints a version.

compose.body: Clone or copy Immich's official docker-compose + .env. Set UPLOAD_LOCATION to a big disk path. docker compose up -d. Wait for healthy.

web.body: Open http://lab-address:2283 (or the port in the compose file). Create the admin user. Do not put this on the public internet yet.

phone.body: Install the Immich app. Server URL is your LAN IP and port. Turn on backup for Camera. Watch a few photos land in the web UI.

stuck.body: Check compose logs, disk space, and that the phone is on the same LAN. Leave it running overnight. Come back for Immich: make it better when uploads click.

done.body: Good. Photos are landing. The next guided project is Immich: make it better — storage, users, and not blowing the disk.
